name: NOWPayments API
tagline: Crypto payment gateway with multi-coin invoices, IPN callbacks, and mass payouts.
description: NOWPayments is a cryptocurrency payment gateway API for accepting payments in many coins and tokens, creating invoices/payments, receiving Instant Payment Notifications (IPN), and running mass payouts. Developers authenticate with an API key and typically verify IPN signatures for webhook security. Suitable for ecommerce checkouts, donation flows, and automated crypto disbursements.

auth.details: API key via x-api-key header (from dashboard). JWT Bearer for some payout/auth flows after email/password login.

use_cases: create a crypto payment invoice for an order
check payment status by payment id
estimate crypto amount for a fiat price
send mass crypto payouts to multiple wallets
verify and process IPN payment webhooks
